name: 2-Arc-Transitive Partial Cubes Are Vertex-Transitive
scope: Finite simple connected graphs under the survey conventions.
statement: Every finite connected 2-arc-transitive partial cube is vertex-transitive.
proof: Transitivity on directed 2-arcs implies transitivity on their initial vertices; the two exceptional connected graphs $K_1$ and $K_2$ are vertex-transitive directly.
